item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00361","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C14","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C23 plausibly supplied a material administrative template for the child’s reporting regime. Both orders regulate government contracting through reports submitted by decentralized contracting agencies to a central authority; authorize that authority to prescribe report forms and required information; and permit categorical exemptions keyed to overseas activity and monetary thresholds. The child adapts this machinery from equal-employment compliance to detecting identical bids and centralizes the reports in the Attorney General. C14 and C08 share procurement-reporting elements, but their operative structures align less closely with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The reports required by section 1 shall be in a form prescribed by the Attorney General and shall include the following information or such other information as he may prescribe","parent_excerpt":"Compliance Reports shall be filed within such times and shall contain such information as to the practices, policies, programs, and employment statistics of the contractor and each subcontractor, and shall be in such form, as the Committee may prescribe.","explanation":"Both establish mandatory contracting-related reports whose form, timing, and informational content are prescribed by a central supervising authority."},{"child_excerpt":"The Attorney General is granted authority to establish reasonable exemptions and variations... [and to] exclude any category of property or services... [or] increase or decrease the $10,000 limit","parent_excerpt":"The Committee may, by rule or regulation, also exempt certain classes of contracts, subcontracts, or purchase orders... involving less than specified amounts of money","explanation":"Both delegate authority to create categorical exemptions and adjust the reporting regime according to monetary thresholds."},{"child_excerpt":"a report shall not be made of bid proceedings in which only foreign sources have participated and in connection with which delivery and performance is to take place outside the United States","parent_excerpt":"exempt certain classes of contracts... where work is to be or has been performed outside the United States and no recruitment of workers within the limits of the United States is involved","explanation":"Both include a specifically framed overseas-performance exemption adapted to the substantive purpose of the respective order."}]}
